entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order or to initiate a return, please press one. For technical support, please press two. For all other inquiries, please press three.
Ugh, finally. One.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. This VeloBand Pulse thing is not what I expected at all. The heart rate is way off.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Hold on. It's... VF78-991-02B. Just get me a return label.
Thank you. Pulling that up now... VF78-991-02B. I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse. Okay, you're well within our 90-day return window, so we can get that started for you.
Great. So you're sending the label?
Yes, I just need to confirm a few... oh, wait actually, let me correct myself. I apologize. I was looking at the general policy for our apparel.
What are you talking about? You just said 90 days.
I know, and I sincerely apologize, I misspoke. For electronic devices like the VeloBand Pulse, the return window is actually 10 days from the date of delivery.
Ten days? Are you kidding me? It was delivered like, two weeks ago! I was on a business trip.

I understand your frustration, and again, I am very sorry for my initial error. Looking at the tracking information, it was delivered 15 days ago, which does put it outside the 10 days return policy for a full refund.
This is ridiculous! You just told me 90 days! The product doesn't even work right. I want to return it. It's basically brand new.

I truly apologize for the confusion I caused, but the policy on this item is firm. I cannot generate a return label for a refund at this point. I can, however, offer you a 20% off coupon for your next purchase with VeloFit.
A coupon? Why would I buy anything else from you people? This is a scam. I want a refund, not a discount on more of your junk.

I understand you're upset. The policy is in place for all electronic fitness trackers. I'm afraid a refund is not an option. Perhaps I could walk you through some troubleshooting steps for the heart rate monitor?
No! I don't want to troubleshoot it, I want my money back! This is unbelievable. First you say yes, then you say no. Just give me my money back.
Sir, I am unable to override the return policy. My system will not allow me to process a return outside the 10-day window for this item.
Then get me someone who can! This is the worst customer service I've ever experienced. Forget it. I'm done with VeloFit.
Sir, I can assure you that my supervisor would inform you of the same po—
